blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep research agents address complex, open-ended information needs through iterative search, evidence selection, and long-form synthesis. They can investigate a topic across multiple sources and produce research reports that connect relevant facts, explain relationships, and organize findings into a coherent account. Unlike short-form question answering, this task requires an agent to decide which research directions deserve investigation, what evidence to gather, and which related knowledge to pursue further. A comprehensive report therefore depends on both covering the major directions relevant to a question and following chains of related knowledge within those directions.
blocks.zh: 深层研究代理商通过迭代搜索,证据选择,和长式合成,解决复杂,开放式的信息需要. 它们可以调查一个涉及多个来源的专题,并编写研究报告,将相关事实联系起来,解释关系,将调查结果组织成一个连贯的叙述。 与短式问题回答不同,这项任务要求代理人决定哪些研究方向值得调查,哪些证据需要收集,哪些相关知识需要进一步追求. 因此,综合报告既要涵盖与问题有关的主要方向,又要遵循这些方向的相关知识链。

blocks.en: Evaluating deep research is challenging because open-ended questions admit multiple valid reports, while a single reference answer rarely captures all relevant knowledge. Factuality checks can identify unsupported statements but cannot penalize omitted knowledge ( Min et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024b ) . Existing benchmarks therefore use expert reports, reference facts, and task-specific rubrics to define expected content and assess factuality, comprehensiveness, citation quality, and writing ( Du et al., 2026 ; Sharma et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Recent approaches further reduce manual effort by generating evaluation criteria from Wikipedia, research graphs, or structured task representations ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , providing explicit criteria for assessing report coverage.
blocks.zh: 评价深入研究具有挑战性,因为开放式问题承认多种有效报告,而单一的参考答案很少能捕捉所有相关知识。 事实检查可以识别无根据的陈述,但不能惩罚遗漏的知情(Min等,2023;Wei等,2024;Song等,2024b.). 因此,现有基准使用专家报告、参考事实和特定任务标题来确定预期内容并评估事实质量、全面性、引用质量和写作(Du等,2026;Sharma等,2026;Li等,2026b)。 近期方法通过从维基百科,研究图表,或结构化的任务表述中生成评价标准来进一步减少人工努力(Wang等,2026c;Wang等,2026d;Dong等,2026;Wang等,2026a),为评估报告涵盖范围提供了明确的标准.

blocks.en:
However, existing benchmarks lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of how broadly and deeply reports cover a structured reference space. Knowledge coverage is typically one component of broader assessments that also consider formatting, organization, and writing style ( Du et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Expert references and manually authored rubrics further limit expansion across domains, while individually specifying or checking detailed criteria makes rubric coverage costly to scale within each task. More fundamentally, even automatically generated criteria lose their relationships under flat aggregation, obscuring whether reports cover more research directions or develop selected directions more deeply.
Recent tree- and DAG-based approaches preserve structure for supervision, task completion, or evidence traceability ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . They do not, however, explicitly treat structured knowledge coverage as their primary evaluation target. Specifically, coverage scores use topology-derived weights that are fixed in advance for each task and do not adapt to interactions among knowledge items covered in a report. Yet the value of a knowledge item also depends on whether it connects to related knowledge that is already covered in the report. Complete-path checks establish whether conclusions have supporting evidence, but do not provide a graded measure of how far coverage extends along a knowledge chain when coverage is partial or interrupted by missing intermediate relations. These limitations leave both the breadth of coverage across research directions and the depth of coverage along related knowledge chains insufficiently characterized (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
然而,现有基准缺乏以知识为中心的专门评价,无法确定报告如何广泛而深入地涵盖结构化的参考空间。 知识的涵盖范围通常是更广泛的评估的一个组成部分,这种评估也考虑到格式化、组织和写作风格(Du等,2026;Wang等,2026b.)。 专家参考资料和人工撰写的题目进一步限制了各领域的扩展,同时个别地具体说明或检查详细标准,使标题涵盖范围在每项任务中都具有成本。 更为根本的是,即使自动产生的标准也丧失了在统一汇总下的关系,从而模糊了报告是涵盖更多的研究方向还是更深入地制定选定的方向。

blocks.en: To fill this gap, we introduce DRBench Pro , a knowledge-centric benchmark that treats structured knowledge coverage as its primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds a local entity–relation tree through multi-hop expansion from a Wikipedia root entity and samples coherent subgraphs defining distinct research scopes. Each subgraph is used to generate both a root-centered research query and a rubric set. Every retained edge defines a rubric grounded in Wikipedia evidence, preserving its structural position in the reference tree. This shared construction aligns task scope with evaluation units and makes each judgment traceable to its originating relation and structural position.

blocks.en: We further propose topology-aware metrics that aggregate edge-level judgments bottom-up over the reference tree. Breadth measures how comprehensively a report covers major research directions, allowing descendant coverage to partially compensate for an omitted relation. Depth measures how far reports develop related knowledge chains, with descendant credit conditioned on whether connecting relations are covered. It rewards continuity while retaining discounted credit beyond missing intermediate relations, providing graded scores for incomplete chains. Subtrees are ranked by their realized coverage in each report to emphasize well-developed chains. Their geometric mean yields overall coverage . Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals substantially interleaved breadth and depth rankings, exposing coverage differences that a single aggregate score can conceal (Figure 1 ). The strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5, achieves 57.04% overall coverage, followed by Grok 4.5 at 50.98%, leaving substantial room for improvement even among frontier agents. Rubric judgments agree with human labels at a Macro-F1 of 0.893, and agent rankings remain stable under perturbations of all metric parameters.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce DRBench Pro, a knowledge-centric benchmark dedicated to structured knowledge coverage in deep research reports, comprising 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 evidence-grounded rubrics , built by an automated pipeline that jointly generates each research query and its hidden rubrics from the same Wikipedia-derived subgraph while preserving the evidence provenance and structural position of every rubric . • We propose topology-aware breadth and depth metrics, together with overall coverage, to distinguish coverage across research directions from progression along related knowledge chains, supported by human-consistency and stability analyses. • We evaluate 16 deep research agents and identify distinct coverage strengths and remaining gaps. We also provide a local research framework with a fixed Wikipedia snapshot, standardized tools, and shared workflow and interaction budgets for controlled evaluation of backbone LLMs.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep research benchmarks evaluate reports through task-specific criteria covering comprehensiveness, factuality, and citation quality ( Du et al., 2026 ; Sharma et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Avraham et al., 2026 ) . Expected content is drawn from expert reports, Wikipedia, generated criteria, or research graphs, with varying degrees of automation in task and rubric construction ( Li et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . For survey-based reports, reference-literature recall and statement veracity measure source coverage and factual accuracy ( Li et al., 2025b ) . Complementary evaluations examine information gathering through broad exploration, passage-retrieval completeness, and exhaustive collection ( Java et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Wong et al., 2026 ; Gupta et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 深度研究基准通过涵盖全面性、事实性和引用质量的具体任务标准对报告进行评价(Du等,2026;Sharma等,2026;Han等,2025;Zhong等,2026;Wang等,2026b;Avraham等,2026)。 预期内容取自专家报告"维基百科",生成的标准,或研究图表,任务和名词构造自动化程度不同(李等,2026b;王等,2026c;王等,2026d;董等,2026.). 关于基于调查的报告,参考文学召回和陈述真实性衡量来源覆盖面和事实准确性(Li等,2025年b) 。 。 。 。 补充评价通过广泛的探索、通过检索的完整性和详尽收集来审查信息收集(Java等人,2026;Kim等人,2026;Wong等人,2026;Gupta等人,2026)。

blocks.en: Factuality and coverage address complementary questions: whether reported claims are supported, and whether relevant information is missing. Claim-level verification and citation audits check generated statements against evidence ( Min et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2024b ; Gao et al., 2023 ; Venkit et al., 2025 ) , while joint analysis of retrieval and generation helps locate failures in systems that use retrieved evidence ( Ru et al., 2024 ) . Coverage evaluation instead identifies omissions by comparing outputs with reference content units and key facts ( Nenkova & Passonneau, 2004 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2024a ; Lee et al., 2024 ) , testing whether they answer reference questions ( Deutsch et al., 2021 ; Scialom et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2024 ) , or checking for salient aspects and insights across documents ( Samarinas et al., 2025 ; Pradeep et al., 2025 ; Laban et al., 2024 ) . Automated rubric generation and judgment calibration support the construction and application of these evaluation criteria ( Rao & Callison-Burch, 2026 ; Hashemi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 事实和覆盖面涉及补充性问题:报告的索赔是否得到支持,是否缺少相关信息。 索赔一级的核实和引用审计核对得出了与证据相符合的报表(Min等,2023;Wei等,2024;Song等,2024b;Gao等,2023;Venkit等,2025;对检索和生成的联合分析有助于查找使用所取出的证据的系统中的故障(Ru等,2024)。 覆盖面评价则通过比较产出与参考内容单位和关键事实来识别遗漏(Nenkova & Passonneau, 2004;Liu等人, 2023;Song等人, 2024a; Lee等人, 2024),测试他们是否回答了参考问题(Deutsch等人, 2021;Scialom等人, 2021;Zhang等人, 2024;Tan等人, 2024),或检查文件的突出方面和深刻见解(Samarinas等人, 2025;Pradeep等人, 2025;Laban等人, 2024)。 自动标分生成和判断校正支持这些评价标准的构建和应用(Rao & Callison-Burch, 2026;Hashim等, 2024)。

blocks.en: Graphs and trees organize multi-hop questions ( Welbl et al., 2018 ; Yang et al., 2018 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Trivedi et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) and synthetic web-search tasks ( Li et al., 2025a ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2025 ; Tao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . For deep research, they connect queries, evidence, and rubrics to support reinforcement learning supervision and propagation of rubric weights ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Structured evidence also enables tracing across research stages and depth and width tests for system comparison ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Using structure to construct tasks or trace evidence is distinct from retaining it to aggregate report coverage. Our benchmark makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target: each rubric retains its position in an entity–relation tree during aggregation, yielding separate breadth and depth measures for coverage across research directions and along related knowledge chains. Table 1 summarizes these distinctions.

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Construction and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3 基准建设和评价议定书

blocks.en: Measuring knowledge coverage requires a reference that specifies both what a report could cover and how that knowledge is organized. We introduce DRBench Pro , which uses Wikipedia-derived knowledge trees to define research tasks and their evaluation criteria within a shared reference space. The tree structure separates major research directions from chains of related knowledge within them, enabling distinct measures of breadth and depth. Figure 2 illustrates the construction and evaluation pipeline. The prompts used for benchmark construction and evaluation are provided in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 衡量知识的涵盖范围需要一份说明报告可涵盖哪些内容以及如何组织知识的参考文件。 我们推出DRBench Pro, 使用维基百科衍生的知识树, 树木结构将主要研究方向与其中的相关知识链相分离,从而能够对广度和深度进行不同的衡量。 图2说明了建设和评价管道。 用于基准建设和评价的提示载于附录J。

(B1) Each sampled subgraph defines a research query. (B2) Each sampled edge is converted into an edge-grounded rubric, forming the hidden rubric set. (C) An evaluated deep research agent answers the query with a report; a judge scores the report against the rubric set, and the edge-level scores are mapped back to the local knowledge tree and aggregated bottom-up into breadth and depth.

blocks.en: 3.1 Wikipedia-derived Local Graph Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 维基百科衍生的本地图形构建

blocks.en: A reference space for knowledge coverage needs to connect research topics with supporting evidence. Wikipedia provides linked entities whose relationships can be examined in their source context. To span diverse domains, we adopt all 24 topic categories from WebOrganizer ( Wettig et al., 2025 ) and select two root entities per category. Each root has a sufficiently detailed, reliably parseable article and enough outgoing links to support expansion.
blocks.zh: 知识覆盖的参考空间需要将研究专题与佐证联系起来。 维基百科提供关联实体,其关系可以在源上下文中检查. 为了跨越不同的领域,我们采用了WebOrganizer公司(Wettig等,2025年)的所有24个专题类别,并每个类别选择两个根实体。 每个根都有一个足够详细,可靠可解的文章和足够的外出链接来支持扩展.

blocks.en: Starting from each root, we expand Wikipedia links breadth-first. Nodes represent entities, and edges represent relationships supported by link anchors and surrounding text. We organize the retained expansion as a rooted tree, with one parent per non-root node and a unique path from the root. This structure gives each relation an identifiable position for subsequent rubric construction and coverage aggregation. Distance from the root is measured by the number of links along this path, and expansion stops at three hops.
blocks.zh: 从每个根开始,我们先扩展维基百科的链接宽度。 节点代表实体,边缘代表由链接站点和周围文本支持的关系. 我们组织保存的扩展为根树,每个非根地节点有一个家长,从根地出发有一个独特的路径. 这一结构使每个关系都有一个可识别的位置,用于随后的标语构建和覆盖汇总. 与根相距由沿着这条路径的链接数来测量,扩展会以3个跳结束.

blocks.en: To provide diverse candidate research directions while bounding the size of deeper expansions, we retain 50 children of the root and at most five children of each other node. Invalid or duplicate candidates are filtered before Claude Opus 4.8 selects neighbors for their relevance to the current entity and usefulness for research tasks. The resulting 48 local knowledge trees contain approximately 1.5K nodes each on average. Appendix A reports detailed statistics, and Appendix C.1 analyzes the choice of two roots per domain. Model-call costs for construction are reported in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 为了提供不同的候选研究方向,同时限制更深的扩张规模,我们保留了50个根部的孩子,最多保存了5个相接节点的孩子. 无效或重复的候选者在克劳德·奥普斯 4.8选择与当前实体相关的邻居和研究任务的有用性之前被过滤. 由此产生的48个当地知识树平均含有约1.5K个节点。 附 录 一份报告详细统计,附录C.1分析每个领域选择两个根. 建筑的模型调用费用见附录H。

blocks.en: 3.2 Subgraph Sampling
blocks.zh: 3.2 分图取样

blocks.en: A full knowledge tree spans more material than a single research request can reasonably target. We therefore sample smaller subgraphs, each defining the scope of one research case. A branch consists of one child of the root and all its descendants: it represents a research direction, while paths within it capture chains of related knowledge. Each case retains the root and 10 complete branches, preserving the knowledge structure within the selected directions.
blocks.zh: 一个完整的知识树比一个研究请求能够合理地瞄准更多的材料。 因此我们抽取了较小的子图,每个子图都确定了一个研究案例的范围. 一个分支由根部的一个子及其所有后人组成:它代表研究方向,而内部的路径则捕捉相关知识的链. 每个案例保留了根和10个完整的分支,保留了选定方向内的知识结构.

blocks.en: To make each scope coherent, Claude Opus 4.8 jointly selects three groups of branches from each tree, using the candidate entities’ page summaries, relations to the root, and descendant information. Branches within a group are selected to provide complementary perspectives on a common research task; the three groups do not share root branches. Retaining complete branches preserves the deeper relations needed to evaluate coverage within each direction. This yields three cases per root and 144 cases across the 24 domains.
blocks.zh: 为了使每个范围一致, Claude Opus 4.8联合从每棵树中选择了三组分支,使用候选实体的页面摘要,与根的关系,和后人信息. 一组内的分支被选取来为共同的研究任务提供互补的观点;这三个组并不共享根分支. 保留完整的分支保持了评估每个方向的覆盖范围所需的更深层关系。 在24个领域,每根有3个病例,144个病例。

blocks.en: 3.3 Query and Rubric Construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 查询和Rubric建筑

blocks.en: The research request and its evaluation criteria should refer to the same knowledge scope. We therefore use Claude Opus 4.8 to generate both the query and the rubrics from each sampled subgraph. For query generation, the model receives the root entity and the sampled knowledge scope, and is instructed to frame a natural research request around their broader themes. The prompt discourages listing hidden entities or restating the subgraph as a checklist, so the agent is asked to investigate a topic rather than reproduce an explicit answer outline.
blocks.zh: 研究请求及其评价标准应提及相同的知识范围。 因此,我们使用克洛德·奥普斯 4.8 来生成从每个被抽样的子图中产生的查询和数字. 对于查询生成,模型接收了"根"实体和被采样的知识范围,并被指示围绕其更广泛的主题来构建自然研究请求. 即时提示劝阻将隐藏实体列出或重新将子图作为核对表,因此要求代理人调查一个话题,而不是复制一个明确的答案大纲.

blocks.en: To make the expected coverage traceable to evidence, we create one rubric per retained relation edge. Each rubric asks whether the report covers the relationship between its source and target entities. The generator uses only the supplied evidence: page summaries, the anchor sentence, relevant paragraphs, and available backlink context from the two pages. This ties each scoring requirement to documented content rather than an unsupported model-generated expectation.
blocks.zh: 为了使预期的覆盖范围能够追踪到证据,我们每保留一个关系边缘就创建出一个分数。 每个标题都询问报告是否涵盖其来源和目标实体之间的关系。 生成器只使用所提供的证据:页面摘要,锚句,相关段落,以及两页可用的回路上下文. 这把每项评分要求都与文件内容相联系,而不是一个没有支持的模型产生的期望。

blocks.en: Each rubric retains its edge’s position in the reference tree, allowing its judgment to be aggregated with those of related rubrics. We also record its hop distance as the distance from the root to the edge’s target node for structural diagnostics. These annotations are kept outside the rubric text. Evaluated agents receive only the query; the reference tree and rubrics remain hidden.
blocks.zh: 每个标题保留其边缘在参考树上的位置,使其判断能与相关标题的判断相加. 我们还将它的跳动距离记录为从根到边缘目标节点进行结构诊断的距离. 这些说明保存在标题外。 被评价的代理只接收查询;参考树和标题仍然被隐藏.

blocks.en: 3.4 Topology-aware Knowledge Coverage Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 地形学知识覆盖评价

blocks.en: Counting satisfied rubrics alone can give similar scores to reports with different coverage patterns. We therefore retain the reference tree when aggregating judgments, distinguishing coverage across research directions from coverage along related knowledge chains. An LLM judge assigns each hidden rubric one of three verdicts: Satisfied , Partially Satisfied , or Not Satisfied . For coverage metric computation, we map Satisfied to 1 1 (covered) and both Partially Satisfied and Not Satisfied to 0 0 (uncovered). These binary values are then aggregated over the reference tree.
blocks.zh: 单算满意的分数,就可以给具有不同覆盖模式的报告以相类似的分数. 因此,我们在汇总判断时保留了参考树,将研究方向的覆盖面与相关知识链的覆盖面区分开来。 LLM法官在三项判决中, 关于覆盖度的计算,我们把满意的1(覆盖)和部分满意的和不满意的2(覆盖)分布到0(未覆盖)。 这些二进制值然后被聚合到参考树上.

blocks.en: Breadth measures how comprehensively a report covers the selected research directions. We give these directions equal weight so that a branch with more rubrics does not dominate the score. Within a branch, deeper relations can demonstrate coverage of a direction even when a shallower relation is missing. We preserve each relation’s direct score as a weighted component and use the mean breadth of its child subtrees to account for descendant coverage. Averaging the resulting branch scores gives case-level breadth.
blocks.zh: Breadth衡量报告如何全面涵盖选定的研究方向。 我们给予这些方向同等的分量,这样一个分数较多的分支就不会占据分数. 在一个分支内,更深层的关系即使缺少更浅层的关系,也能显示对某一方向的覆盖. 我们保留每个关系的直接分数作为加权部分,并使用其子树的平均宽度来说明后代的覆盖率。 演绎由此而来分出分会给案例层带来宽度.

blocks.en: Depth measures coverage along related knowledge chains in the reference tree. A report can cover one chain deeply without covering every branch equally, so we give greater weight to child subtrees with higher depth scores while retaining smaller contributions from the others. Each relation contributes its own score and regulates how much descendant coverage is credited: an uncovered intermediate relation reduces that credit without discarding it. This rewards continuity along knowledge chains. We apply the same rank-based weighting across the selected research directions to obtain case-level depth. Appendix C.5 analyzes the textual organization of supporting evidence for consecutive satisfied rubrics.
blocks.zh: 深度测量参考树上相关知识链的覆盖范围。 报告可以深入地涵盖一个链条,而不平等地涵盖每个分支,因此我们对深度分数较高的子树给予更大的分量,同时保留其他树的较小贡献. 每种关系都贡献了自己的分数,并规范了子孙的信用范围:一个被发现的中间关系会减少这种信用,而不放弃它. 这有利于知识链的连续性。 我们在选定的研究方向上采用相同的等级加权法,以获得案例的深度。 附录C.5分析了连续满意标题的佐证证据的文字结构。

blocks.en: We combine case-level breadth B c B_{c} and depth D c D_{c} through their geometric mean, S c = B c ​ D c , S_{c}=\sqrt{B_{c}D_{c}}, (1) so weak coverage in either dimension lowers the combined score. Each of the three metrics is then averaged separately across the 144 cases.
blocks.zh: 我们把案例的广度B c B_{c}和深度D c D_{c}通过它们的几何平均值,S c = B C D C, S_{c}=\sqt{ B_{c} D_{c}}, (1) 任何一个维度的覆盖率都太低,降低了综合分数。 然后,在144个个案中,三个衡量标准各自分别进行平均。

blocks.en: Both metrics are computed from the leaves toward the root, starting with the direct rubric scores and recursively combining them with descendant coverage. Appendix B provides the complete procedure in Algorithm 1 , together with the equations, parameter definitions, and boundary conventions.
blocks.zh: 两个度量衡都是从叶子到根来计算,从直接的分数开始,并递相将分数与后人覆盖相结合. 附 录 B提供了算法 1 中的完整程序,以及等式、参数定义和边界公约。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 16 deep research agents and group them into three categories according to how search and research orchestration are provided.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了16个深层研究代理商,并根据如何提供搜索和研究的管弦法将其分为三类。

blocks.en: These are end-to-end research agents explicitly designed for autonomous, long-horizon investigation. They natively combine planning, iterative evidence gathering, and long-form synthesis. We evaluate o3 Deep Research, Perplexity Sonar Deep Research, and Qwen Deep Research.
blocks.zh: 这些是端到端的研究代理人,明确设计用于自主的长视距调查. 它们原生地结合了规划,迭代证据收集,和长式合成. 我们评价o3深层研究, 疑惑声纳深层研究, 和Quen深层研究。

blocks.en: These models integrate provider-native web search directly into generation without relying on a separate Deep Research product workflow. We evaluate Grok 4.5, Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Sonar Reasoning Pro, and Qwen3.8 Max with native web search enabled.
blocks.zh: 这些模型将提供者-本地网络搜索直接集成到生成过程中,而不依赖于单独的"深度研究"产品工作流程. 我们评价Grok 4.5, Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, 双子座3.1 Pro预览,声纳理性 Pro, 和 Qune3.8 Max, 启用本地网络搜索。

blocks.en: As a controlled and reproducible evaluation setting, we implement the local research framework backed by the fixed English Wikipedia dump enwiki-20260701-v1 . The framework exposes Search and Open operations over the same snapshot, disables provider-native web search, and keeps the research workflow and budget fixed across backbone LLMs. Its purpose is to provide a common search service into which different backbone LLMs can be integrated, rather than to improve their benchmark scores. This design removes temporal drift in the retrieval corpus, reduces variation from external search infrastructure, and retains auditable evidence records. We evaluate Gemma 4 31B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.8 Max, Qwen3.7 Plus, GLM 5.2, and MiniMax M3 as backbone LLMs. The execution protocol and formal configuration of the local research framework are detailed in Appendix F . Appendix D.5 evaluates LangChain Open Deep Research with DeepSeek V4 Flash on a small sample.
blocks.zh: 作为可控和可再生的评价环境,我们实施由固定的英语维基百科 enwiki-20260701-v1支持的地方研究框架. 该框架将搜索和开放操作暴露在同一快照上,禁用供应商-本地网络搜索,并保持研究工作流程和预算固定在主干LLMs之间. 其目的是提供一个共同的搜索服务,将不同的主干LLM纳入其中,而不是改进其基准分数. 这种设计可以去除检索器中的时间漂移,减少外部搜索基础设施的变异,并保留可审计的证据记录. 我们评价了Gemma 4 31B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Quen3.8 Max, Quen3.7. 另外,GLM 5.2,和MiniMax M3作为骨干LLM. 地方研究框架的执行规程和正式配置详见附录F. 附录D.5评价了LangChain开放深层研究与DeepSeek V4 闪耀在小样本上。

blocks.en: The evaluated reports were collected during the periods listed in Appendix G . We use Gemini 2.5 Pro as the judge for the formal evaluation. It assigns each rubric one of three verdicts: Satisfied , Partially Satisfied , or Not Satisfied . We retain these original judgments and convert them into binary rubric scores of 0 0 or 1 1 for the metrics in Section 3.4 . Appendix H reports the recorded model-call costs for report generation and judge evaluation.
blocks.zh: 评价报告是在附录G所列期间收集的。 我们使用双子座2.5 Pro作为正式评价的法官. 它分配了三个判决中的一个标题:满意、部分满意或不满意。 我们保留了这些原始的判断, 并把它们转换成二进制分数 0 或 1 1 对于第3.4节的度量. 附 录 H报告了记录的生成报告和评委评价的示范调用费用。

blocks.zh: 4.2 评价结果

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that Claude Opus 5 achieves the highest overall coverage (57.04%) and ranks first in both breadth (53.09%) and depth (61.91%), yielding strong performance in both dimensions. Grok 4.5 and o3 Deep Research follow, with relatively stronger breadth and depth, respectively. High overall coverage therefore requires both comprehensive coverage across major directions and progress along related knowledge chains. Appendix C.3 lists selected results from prior benchmarks for context.
blocks.zh: 表2显示克洛德·奥普斯5的总覆盖率最高(57.04%),在广度(53.09%)和深度(61.91%)上位居第一,在两个维度上都取得了强劲的表现. Grok 4.5和o3"深研究"相继出现,相去甚远的广度和深度分别相对较强. 因此,全面覆盖范围很广,既需要覆盖各主要方向,也需要在相关知识链方面取得进展。 附录C.3列出了以往背景基准的选定结果。

blocks.en: The agent orderings differ substantially between breadth and depth, revealing distinct research strengths and showing that research workflows can produce markedly different coverage profiles. The clearest example is Qwen3.8 Max: under the local research framework, its breadth and depth scores are 15.54 and 6.28 percentage points higher, respectively, than under its Native Search configuration, with the difference concentrated primarily in breadth. The two configurations of the same-named model therefore exhibit different knowledge-exploration patterns: the local research framework configuration covers major research directions more comprehensively, whereas the depth difference is comparatively limited. A similar contrast appears within the Perplexity product line: Perplexity Sonar Deep Research attains higher depth but slightly lower breadth than Sonar Reasoning Pro. Together, these results show that breadth and depth expose agent specializations and research-strategy differences that overall coverage alone cannot reveal.
blocks.zh: 代理人订购的广度和深度差别很大,揭示出不同的研究长处并显示研究工作流程可以产生明显不同的覆盖概况. 最明显的例子是Quen3.8 Max:在本地研究框架下,其广度和深度的分数分别比其"本土搜索"配置下高出15.54分和6.28分,差异主要集中在宽度上. 因此,同名模型的两种配置显示出不同的知识探索模式:地方研究框架的配置更全面地涵盖主要的研究方向,而深度差异相对有限。 在复杂产品线内也出现了类似的对比: 相较于声纳理性Pro,声纳深度研究的深度更高但宽度略低. 这些结果共同表明,广度和深度暴露了物剂专门化和研究-战略差异,而光是总体覆盖面是无法揭示的.

blocks.en: Figure 3 presents two representative cases. For Lew Grade, similar overall coverage masks a breadth–depth trade-off. For Temperance, agents can deepen their investigations along different knowledge paths. Appendix E presents the case studies in greater detail. Appendix E.4 provides a full report with rubric judgments and highlighted evidence.
blocks.zh: 图3列出了两个有代表性的案例。 对Lew Grade来说,类似的总体覆盖掩盖了宽度-深度取舍。 对于Temperance,特工人员可以通过不同的知识途径深化调查. 附 录 E更详细地介绍了案例研究。 附录E.4提供了一份全面报告,其中列有重大判决和突出证据。

blocks.en: Under the local research framework, Qwen3.8 Max achieves the highest overall coverage (47.94%). Several backbone LLMs remain competitive under a limited budget. Among the leading backbones, breadth scores are already relatively close, whereas differences in depth further separate their overall coverage. Because these models share the same knowledge source, workflow, tool-use constraints, and budget, the remaining differences reflect backbone-dependent behavior in task decomposition, tool use, evidence selection, and report synthesis. Appendix D.2 analyzes the agents’ research trajectories. Appendices D.3 and D.4 analyze length sensitivity and retrieval-to-report knowledge retention.
blocks.zh: 在地方研究框架下,Quen3.8 Max实现了最高的整体覆盖率(47.94%). 在有限的预算下,一些主干地方政府仍然具有竞争力。 在领先的骨干中,宽度分数已经相对接近,而深度差异则进一步将其整体覆盖分开. 由于这些模型共享相同的知识源,工作流程,工具使用限制,以及预算,所剩差异反映了任务分解,工具使用,证据选择以及报告综合中依赖骨干的行为. 附录D.2分析剂的研究轨迹。 附录D.3和D.4分析长度敏感性和检索到报告的知识保留。

blocks.zh: 4.3 全域覆盖概况

blocks.en: 4.4 Research Task Quality and Leakage
blocks.zh: 4.4 研究任务的质量和泄漏

blocks.en: Because each research query is generated from a sampled subgraph, we manually review all 144 queries using three criteria: research value, public answerability, and alignment with their assigned domains (Table 4 ). All are rated Good on the first two criteria; 141 are Good and three Medium on domain match.
blocks.zh: 由于每个研究查询都是由被抽样的子图生成的,所以我们用三个标准对所有144个查询进行手动审查:研究值,公众可回答性,以及与其指定域的对接(表4). 均被评为"Good"在前两个标准上;141为"Good",3为"Medium"在域名匹配上.

blocks.en: The three Medium cases arise from natural cross-domain overlap, as subgraph sampling produces topic-specific research scopes that are not necessarily confined to a single domain; the queries nevertheless remain coherent, publicly answerable, and sufficiently aligned with their assigned domains for benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这三个中型案例来自自然的跨域重叠,因为子图抽样生成的专题特定研究范围不一定局限于一个领域;然而,这些查询仍然一致、公开回答,并充分符合基准评价指定领域。

blocks.en: We also check whether queries reveal the hidden entity information used for evaluation. For each of 24 sampled cases (one per domain), we compare its query with every non-root entity title in its subgraph, yielding 7,385 query–entity comparisons, and manually review literal matches. The 34 generic-term overlaps arise because some subgraph titles, or components of those titles, are ordinary words or phrases that naturally occur in research queries and therefore do not unambiguously identify the corresponding entities. These overlaps are excluded from the leakage count. 8 entity-title mentions are confirmed as leaks, with none at the first hop (Table 4 ). Therefore, the low leakage rate is unlikely to materially affect subsequent report generation or benchmark evaluation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce DRBench Pro , a knowledge-centric benchmark for professional deep research agents. From each sampled multi-hop Wikipedia-derived entity subgraph, it jointly generates a research query and traceable edge-grounded rubrics, giving the case, knowledge scope, and evaluation criteria a shared structural foundation. Topology-aware aggregation captures breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean yielding overall coverage. Evaluation across 16 deep research agents reveals interleaved breadth–depth profiles; with the knowledge source, workflow, tool interface, and interaction budget fixed, the local research framework further distinguishes the coverage behavior of different backbone LLMs. Overall, DRBench Pro uses graph topology in both benchmark construction and metric formulation, providing a scalable, structure-aware foundation for evaluating knowledge coverage in deep research reports.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DRBench Pro, 一个以知识为中心的基准 专业的深层研究人员。 从每个被取样的多跳维基百科衍生实体子图中,它联合生成一个研究查询和可追踪的边缘地标,赋予案例,知识范围,评价标准一个共享的结构基础. 地理学认识聚合在相关知识链上捕捉主要研究方向和深度的广度,其几何表示产生总体覆盖。 对16个深层研究代理人的评价揭示了互放的广度 — — 深度简介;随着知识源、工作流程、工具界面和互动预算的固定,地方研究框架进一步区分了不同主干LLM的覆盖行为。 总体而言,DRBench Pro在基准构建和量子配制中都使用图表地貌,为在深入研究报告中评价知识覆盖范围提供了一个可扩展的、有结构意识的基础。

blocks.en: C.2 Research Query Quality Criteria
blocks.zh: C.2 研究查询质量标准

blocks.en: This criterion asks whether the query warrants a research report. A strong query calls for substantive investigation, retrieval, and synthesis across relevant evidence; a request answerable through a short factual lookup has limited research value.
blocks.zh: 该标准询问询问是否需要一份研究报告。 强烈的询问要求对相关证据进行实质性调查、检索和综合;通过简短的事实调查答复请求,研究价值有限。

blocks.en: This criterion asks whether reliable, publicly available sources can, in principle, support an answer to the query. The answer need not appear in a single source, but the requested findings must be verifiable without private information or unsupported speculation.
blocks.zh: 这一标准询问可靠、公开的来源原则上能否支持对查询的回答。 答案不需要出现在一个单一的资料来源中,但所要求的调查结果必须是可核查的,没有私人信息或没有支持的猜测.

blocks.en: This criterion asks whether the query’s central topic and requested analysis fit its assigned domain. The domain is shown alongside the query during review. Cross-domain connections are compatible with a match when the assigned domain remains central; a merely incidental connection is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 此标准询问该查询的中心话题和要求的分析是否符合其指定领域。 复议期间,域与查询同时显示. 跨域连接在指定域仍为中心时与匹配兼容;仅仅是偶然连接是不够的.

The corresponding OpenAI–Perplexity product-family ordering also appears in the selected dimensions of DeepResearch Bench ( Du et al., 2026 ) , DeepResearch Bench II ( Li et al., 2026b ) , ResearchRubrics, Wiki Live Challenge’s Broad metric ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , DeepResearchEval ( Wang et al., 2026d ) , and LiveResearchBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . The advantage of o3 Deep Research over Qwen Deep Research is also consistent with the corresponding product-family results in DeepResearch Bench II, Wiki Live Challenge, and DeepResearchEval. Among native-search models, LiveResearchBench orders GPT-5 above Gemini 2.5 Pro and Sonar Reasoning Pro, matching the overall-coverage order of the corresponding model families in Table 2 . Although versions and protocols differ, these recurring relative advantages provide useful external context for our results.

blocks.en: C.5 Textual Organization of Covered Knowledge Chains

blocks.en: To address the concern about whether consecutive knowledge relations in the reference tree are also coherently presented in the report, we examine the textual proximity of their supporting evidence and how related knowledge is connected across sections.
blocks.zh: 为了解决关于参考树上连续的知识关系是否也在报告中连贯地提出的关切,我们审查了其佐证证据在文字上的相近性以及相关知识如何在各节之间相互联系。

blocks.en: Table 16 : Evidence locality for consecutive satisfied rubrics. Same-section rate measures the proportion of covered chains whose supporting evidence lies in the same main body section, averaged equally across reports.
blocks.zh: 表16:连续满意项目的证据位置。 同一部分的比率衡量各份报告中同一主体部分中支持证据的覆盖链条的比例。

blocks.en: To this end, we analyzed 500 sampled reports. For groups of consecutive rubrics originally judged satisfied, we used Qwen3.8 Flash to locate supporting evidence sentences and checked whether they appeared in the same main body section. A main body section is a thematic division of the report, identified from its heading hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们分析了500份抽样报告。 对于最初判断满意的相继数组,我们使用Qune3.8 Flash来定位辅助证据句并检查它们是否出现在同一个正文部分. 主体部分是报告的主题分,从标题分级中确定.

blocks.en: In this subset, evidence for both chain lengths is predominantly located within the same main body section (Table 16 ). We further inspected examples where the supporting evidence appeared in different sections and found that knowledge points in a coherent logical chain do not necessarily have to appear consecutively in the text. Reports may devote separate sections to different explanatory steps, analytical dimensions, or historical stages, or introduce a phenomenon in one section before tracing its origins in another. In such cases, mechanisms, supporting evidence, sources, or applicability conditions can connect explanations across sections and sustain meaningful progression. Appendix E.4 illustrates how evidence from different report sections can support a coherent knowledge chain.
blocks.zh: 在这个子集中,两个链长的证据主要位于同一个正体部分(表16.). 我们进一步检查了证明证据出现在不同章节中的例子,发现在连贯的逻辑链条中的知识点不一定必须连续出现在文本中。 报告可单独分节阐述不同的解释步骤、分析方面或历史阶段,或在某一节中引入一种现象,然后再从另一节中追查其根源。 在这种情况下,各种机制、辅助证据、来源或适用性条件可以将各节的解释联系起来,并保持有意义的进展。 附录E.4说明了不同报告部分的证据如何支持连贯一致的知识链。

Process profiles under the local research framework. To examine the research processes behind the final reports, we next focus on the seven backbone LLMs under the local research framework, for which complete trajectories are available under a unified setting.
All seven backbone LLMs share the same Wikipedia snapshot, Search/Open interface, research workflow, and action budget. We analyze the complete 144 × 7 = 1,008 144\times 7=1{,}008 trajectories and jointly report overall coverage, breadth, and depth together with six process observables: final-report length, issued Search calls, unique retrieved Wikipedia pages, issued Open calls, Gap Unit incidence, and source-ID-valid citation markers. Table 18 provides the exact means, and Figure 7 visualizes the process profiles.
blocks.zh:
地方研究框架下的流程简介。 为了审查最后报告背后的研究过程,我们接下来的重点是地方研究框架下的7个主干法学硕士课程,这些课程的完整轨迹可在统一环境下提供。
所有7个主干LLMs共享同名维基百科快照,搜索/开放界面,研究工作流程,以及行动预算. 我们分析144×7=1 008 144\时 7=1{,}008 轨迹并联合报告总体覆盖,广度和深度,以及六个进程可观测:最终报告长度,发布搜索呼叫,唯一检索的维基百科页面,发布 打开调用, Gap Unit 事件, 以及源 -ID - 有效引用标记 。 表18提供了确切的手段,图7可视化了流程简介.

blocks.en: Even under this unified setting, the backbones exhibit distinct research processes. Their Search-call counts are similar, but retrieved pages, Open calls, Research Unit usage, valid citations, and final-report length vary substantially. For example, Gap Unit usage is only weakly associated with coverage performance, suggesting that strong performance depends more on effective planning than on simply expanding the number of Research Units.
blocks.zh: 即使在这种统一环境下,骨干也显示出不同的研究过程. 它们的搜索呼叫计数相似,但检索到的页面、开放通话、研究股的使用、有效引用和最后报告长度差别很大。 例如,差距股的使用与覆盖性能关系不大,这表明强效性能更多地取决于有效的规划,而不是简单地扩大研究股的数目。

blocks.en: Table 18: Coverage and process profiles under the local research framework. Gap Unit is the percentage of cases that trigger an additional Research Unit.
blocks.zh: 表18:地方研究框架下的覆盖范围和流程简介。 差距股是导致增设研究股的案件的百分比。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Research-process profiles under the local research framework: (a) final-report length, (b) issued Search calls, (c) unique retrieved Wikipedia pages, (d) issued Open calls, (e) Gap Unit incidence, and (f) source-ID-valid citation markers. Dashed lines mark the mean of the seven displayed backbone-LLM means.
blocks.zh: 图7:地方研究框架下的研究流程简介:(a)最终报告长度,(b)发布搜索呼叫,(c)唯一检索到的维基百科页面,(d)发布Open呼叫,(e)漏洞单位事件,(f)源-ID-验证引用标记. 折叠线标记了显示的7个主干-LLM的表示.

blocks.en: D.3 Sensitivity Analysis under a Common Target Length
blocks.zh: D.3 共同目标长度下的敏感性分析

blocks.en: More comprehensive knowledge coverage can require more space, as additional substantive facts and relations may satisfy more reference rubrics. ResearchRubrics ( Sharma et al., 2026 ) notes this relationship while acknowledging potential verbosity bias; LiveResearchBench ( Wang et al., 2026b ) uses generous output budgets. Imposing identical report lengths adds compression and content-selection constraints, changing the evaluation target. Our primary setting therefore allows systems to develop reports within their configured research budgets. However, to assess sensitivity to output-length constraints, we also examine coverage performance under a common report-length budget. We additionally reran all seven local backbones on 24 cases, one from each of the 24 domains, retaining research settings while targeting 1,200 words.
blocks.zh: 更全面的知识覆盖面可能需要更多的空间,因为更多的实质性事实和关系可能满足更多的参考主题。 ResearchRubrics(Sharma等,2026年)注意到了这种关系,同时承认了潜在的动词偏差;LiveResearch Bench(Wang等,2026年b)使用了慷慨的产出预算. 规定相同的报告长度增加了压缩和内容选择的限制,改变了评价目标。 因此,我们的主要环境允许各系统在其配置的研究预算范围内编写报告。 然而,为了评估对产出长度限制的敏感性,我们还根据一个共同的报告长度预算审查覆盖情况。 此外,我们还针对24个案例重新调整所有7个地方骨干,24个领域各1个,保留研究环境,同时针对1 200个字。

blocks.en: Table 19 : Original and target-length results averaged over the same 24 cases. The report-length target is 1,200 words.
blocks.zh: 表19:相同24个案例的原始和目标长度结果平均值。 报告长度的目标是1200个字。

blocks.en: Table 19 shows that differences in knowledge coverage persist under a common length target, with some changes in the relative ordering of the models. The same three models remain at the top, although their ordering changes. For example, Qwen3.8 Max and DeepSeek V4 Pro have similar lengths (1,198 vs. 1,239 words) but differ by 5.24 Overall percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表19显示,在共同长度目标下,知识覆盖面的差异依然存在,模型的相对顺序也有所变化。 同样的三种型号仍然处于上位,尽管它们的订单有变化. 例如: Quen3.8 Max和 DeepSeek V4 Pro的长度相近(1,198个字对1,239个字),但总百分比相差5.24分.

blocks.en: Although we explicitly specified a common length target, adherence varied across models: MiniMax and GLM tended to exceed it, whereas Gemma tended to fall short. Nevertheless, average report lengths became substantially closer, providing a more comparable basis for this supplementary evaluation.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们明确规定了一个共同的长度目标,但各模型的遵守程度各不相同:MiniMax和GLM倾向于超过它,而Gemma倾向于低于它。 尽管如此,平均报告长度已大大接近,为本补充评价提供了更可比较的基础。

blocks.en: D.4 Retrieval-to-report Coverage and Knowledge Retention
blocks.zh: D.4 检索到报告的覆盖面和知识保留

blocks.en: Most deep research agents likely follow a multi-stage workflow, retrieving broadly before selecting material for the final report. Knowledge omitted during writing may reflect their own preferences regarding which knowledge to include. We therefore apply our evaluation method to examine different models’ breadth and depth preferences during retrieval and writing, together with their retention of retrieved knowledge.
blocks.zh: 大多数深层研究人员可能遵循多阶段工作流程,在为最后报告选择材料之前广泛检索。 在写作过程中省略的知识可能反映他们自己对包括哪些知识的偏好。 因此,我们运用我们的评估方法,在检索和撰写过程中审查不同模型的广度和深度偏好,以及保留检索到的知识。

blocks.en: To this end, we evaluated retrieval and report coverage on 24 cases for the seven backbone LLMs evaluated under the local research framework. At the retrieval stage, we collected the retrieved materials and measured the model’s knowledge coverage at this stage in terms of Breadth and Depth. At the writing stage, we evaluated the final reports using the same method. Table 20 compares breadth and depth at the retrieval and report stages, and Table 21 reports rubric-level retention overall and by hop distance.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们评价了根据当地研究框架评价的7个主干有限责任公司24个案例的检索和报告。 在检索阶段,我们收集了检索到的材料,并以Breadth和Depth的角度衡量了模型的知识覆盖范围。 在撰写阶段,我们用同样的方法评价了最后报告。 表20比较了检索和报告阶段的广度和深度,表21则按总体水平和跳出距离比较了保留率。

blocks.en: Table 20 : Retrieval-to-report coverage and final-report performance. Arrows indicate retrieval → \rightarrow report; percentages in parentheses denote report-to-retrieval ratios of mean scores. Overall scores refer to the final reports. Models are ordered by their final-report Overall scores in descending order.
blocks.zh: 表20:检索到报告的覆盖面和最后报告的执行情况。 箭头表示检索=\正弦报告;括号中的百分比表示报告与检索的平均分数的比率。 总体分数指最后报告。 模型按其最终报告的总得分顺序排列。

blocks.en: Table 21 : Knowledge retention overall and by hop distance. Retention measures the proportion of fully covered retrieval rubrics retained in the final reports.
blocks.zh: 表21:总体知识保留和跳动距离。 保留衡量最后报告中保留完全覆盖的检索标题的比例。

blocks.en: Overall, 47.0% of fully covered retrieval rubric instances are no longer fully covered in reports, and knowledge retention decreases as hop distance increases. Models also differ in what they preserve: DeepSeek Pro preserves more of its Depth than Breadth score (92.4% vs. 80.4%), suggesting more focused coverage along selected chains. Flash better preserves Breadth (89.9% vs. 80.7% for Depth), consistent with retaining topical range while compressing deeper content. Qwen3.8 Max maintains high score retention in both dimensions (89.8%/91.8%) and retains the most retrieved knowledge (65.6%), showing stronger coverage preservation during synthesis.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,47.0%的完全覆盖的检索标点实例不再完全纳入报告,随着跳行距离的扩大,知识保留量也有所减少。 模型保存的内容也各不相同: DeepSeek Pro保留了比Breadth分数(92.4%对80.4%)更多的深度,表明沿着所选链条的覆盖范围更有重点. Flash较好地保存了Breadth(89.9%对80.7%的深度),与保留话题范围同时压缩更深的内容一致. Qune3.8 Max在两个维度上都保持高分保留(89.8%/91.8%)并保留了最可检索的知识(65.6%),显示在合成过程中的覆盖范围保存更强.

blocks.en: Evaluating retrieval and reporting separately distinguishes retrieval gaps from omissions of already retrieved knowledge in the final report. This offers valuable guidance for improving retrieval and knowledge retention during synthesis.
blocks.zh: 评价检索和报告将检索差距与最后报告中已检索知识的遗漏区分开来。 这为改进综合过程中的检索和知识保留提供了宝贵的指导。

blocks.en: D.5 Supplementary Evaluation of Open Deep Research
blocks.zh: D.5 开放深层研究的补充评价

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate an open-source deep research harness to broaden the range of research systems evaluated by our benchmark. We evaluate LangChain Open Deep Research (ODR) with DeepSeek V4 Flash, using Tavily for web search, on 24 sampled cases. Table 23 reports the scores of the original 16 agents on the same 24 cases.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估一个开放源码的深层研究手段,以扩大根据我们的基准评估的研究系统的范围。 我们用DeepSeek V4 Flash, 利用Tavily进行网络搜索, 对24个抽样案例进行LangChain Open Deep Research(ODR)的评价. 表23为同一24个案件的16名原始代理人的分数。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 22 , ODR achieves Overall and Depth scores 11.67 and 16.81 percentage points higher than the local configuration, respectively, also exceeding o3 Deep Research on this subset. Its larger exploration budget, iterative supervision, and evidence synthesis may contribute to these gains. These results illustrate the value of evaluating complete research configurations alongside backbone LLMs. Broader evaluation across additional harnesses and backbone models under matched research budgets remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 如表22所示,网上解决总体成绩和深度成绩分别比当地配置高11.67分和16.81分,也超过了O3深度研究这一子集. 其更大的勘探预算、迭代监督和证据综合可能有助于这些收益。 这些结果表明,与主干法学硕士同时评价完整的研究配置具有价值。 在相应的研究预算下,更广泛的评价涵盖更多优势和主干模式,这仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

Results and research activity are averaged over the same 24 cases. Coverage scores are reported as percentages. † \dagger Model-call records use configuration-specific counting conventions; approximately 92% of ODR responses are used for webpage summarization. “—” indicates unavailable internal counts.
blocks.zh: 表22:朗彩开放深度研究的补充评价. 网上解决和地方研究框架都使用DeepSeek V4 Flash. 同24个案例的结果和研究活动平均。 覆盖面分数按百分比报告。 \dagger 模式调用记录使用特定配置计数惯例;大约92%的网上解决答复用于网页汇总。 “-”表示没有内部统计。

blocks.en: Appendix E Case Study
blocks.zh: 附录E 案例研究

blocks.en: We use three diagnostic cases to connect aggregate scores to concrete report behavior. The first requires similar overall coverage with a crossed breadth–depth profile; the second examines reports that follow largely different chains of related knowledge within the same research space; and the third is restricted to the unified local research framework and contrasts higher research activity with lower coverage performance.
blocks.zh: 我们用三个诊断病例 把总分和具体报告行为联系起来 第一种需要类似的全面覆盖,具有跨广的深度;第二种需要审查报告,这些报告遵循的是同一研究空间内基本不同的相关知识链;第三种限于统一的当地研究框架,比较较高的研究活动,其覆盖性较低。

blocks.en: E.1 Similar Overall Coverage Can Hide Different Research Strategies
blocks.zh: E.1 类似的全面覆盖可以掩盖不同的研究战略

blocks.en: I’m trying to understand the career of the British entertainment mogul Lew Grade, particularly his transition from television into big-budget international film production during the 1970s and early 1980s. I’d like a well-researched overview that explains how his instincts and financing strategies produced both remarkable successes and costly failures, and how these outcomes shaped his reputation and financial standing over time. Rather than just listing his projects, I’m interested in the bigger picture: why he pursued ambitious, prestige, and family-oriented entertainment for global audiences, how his partnerships with major directors and creative figures worked in practice, and what balance of artistic risk and commercial calculation drove his decisions. I’d also like to understand how a combination of overreach and shifting business pressures eventually undermined his control of his own company and led to a corporate takeover. Please connect his personal management style to the broader changes in how film and television were financed and distributed during his era, and assess how his legacy has been judged.
blocks.zh: 我试图了解英国娱乐界的Mogul Lew Grade的生涯,特别是他在20世纪70年代和80年代初从电视向大预算国际电影制作的转变. 以及这些结果如何塑造他的声誉和财务地位。 与其只是列举他的项目,我更感兴趣的是大局:他为什么追求雄心勃勃、威望和面向家庭的全球观众娱乐,他与主要导演和创意人物的合作关系在实践中如何运作,艺术风险和商业计算如何平衡促使他作出决定。 我也很想知道, 过度介入和不断变化的商业压力, 最终会削弱他对公司的控制, 请将他的个人管理风格与他时代电影和电视的筹资和发行方式的更广义变化联系起来,并评估他的遗产是如何被评价的.

blocks.en: Perplexity Sonar Deep Research and Grok 4.5 obtain similar overall coverage on this case (38.83 vs. 40.31), despite exhibiting sharply inverted coverage profiles. Perplexity Sonar Deep Research covers major research directions less comprehensively but follows chains of related knowledge farther within selected directions (breadth 27.33, depth 55.19). By contrast, Grok 4.5 exhibits the opposite pattern (breadth 54.48, depth 29.82). Figure 8 shows how these contrasting profiles can yield similar overall coverage scores.
blocks.zh: Sonar Deep Research和Grok 4.5对此案(38.83诉40.31)获得了类似的总体报道,尽管所显示的报导范围大为颠倒。 声纳深层研究涵盖的主要研究方向不太全面,而是在选定方向内更深入地遵循相关知识链(breadth 27.33,深度55.19)。 相形之下,Grok 4.5呈现出相反的模式(breadth 54.48,深度 29.82). 图8显示这些对比性简介如何能够得出类似的总体覆盖分数。

blocks.en: This case illustrates a general limitation of scalar report evaluation: similar aggregate performance does not imply similar research behavior. One report covers major research directions more comprehensively, while the other follows chains of related knowledge farther within selected directions.
blocks.zh: 这个案例说明了scalar报告评价的一般局限性:类似的汇总性能并不意味着类似的研究行为. 一份报告更全面地涵盖主要的研究方向,而另一份报告则更深入地遵循选定方向内的相关知识链。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Similar overall coverage can conceal different research strategies. Bars show aggregate breadth and depth (%). Gray rays mark ten shared research directions. Colored ray width and opacity encode branch breadth, while ray length encodes branch depth.
blocks.zh: 图8:类似的总体覆盖可以掩盖不同的研究策略. 栏显示总宽和深度(%)。 灰色射线标志着十个共同的研究方向. 有色射线宽度和不透明编码分支宽度,而射线长度编码分支深度.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Deep research can explore different knowledge paths. Values above the models report overall coverage, breadth, and depth (%). Matched gray rays mark the same research directions. Colored ray width and opacity encode branch breadth, while ray length encodes branch depth.
blocks.zh: 图9:深度研究可以探索不同的知识路径. 模型之上的数值报告总体覆盖面、广度和深度(%)。 相匹配的灰色射线标记相同的研究方向. 有色射线宽度和不透明编码分支宽度,而射线长度编码分支深度.

blocks.en: E.2 Deep Research Can Explore Different Knowledge Paths
blocks.zh: E.2 深入研究 可以探索不同的知识路径

blocks.en: I’m trying to understand the temperance movement not just as a campaign against alcohol, but as a broad historical phenomenon that grew out of specific social conditions and then spread and changed in surprising ways. I’d like a research-style report that traces how early alarm over heavy drinking in one society, combined with new medical and moral arguments, laid the groundwork for organized reform. I’m especially curious about how different religious traditions shaped competing versions of the movement, giving it distinct doctrinal flavors and leaders, and how this influenced its appeal across communities. Beyond its origins in Britain and America, I’d like to understand how the movement traveled to colonial and settler societies, where it became entangled with other causes like women’s political rights and, strikingly, with anti-colonial and independence struggles and religious revivals. Please explain how these motivations interacted, why the same idea took on such different meanings in different places, and what tensions or contradictions emerged as it evolved, without simply listing every organization or figure involved.
blocks.zh: 我试图理解温和运动不仅仅是一场反对酒精的运动, 而是一个广泛的历史现象, 以及新的医学和道德观点, 为有组织的改革奠定了基础。 我尤其好奇的是,不同的宗教传统如何塑造了运动的相互竞争的版本,赋予了运动独特的理论风味和领袖,以及这如何影响运动在社区中的吸引力。 除了起源于英国和美国之外,我想了解这场运动是如何去殖民和定居社会的,它与诸如妇女的政治权利等其他原因纠缠在一起,并引人注目地与反殖民和独立斗争以及宗教复兴纠缠在一起的。 请解释这些动机是如何相互作用的,为什么同一想法在不同的地方具有这些不同的含义,以及随着演变而出现的紧张或矛盾,而不简单地列举每个所涉组织或人物。

blocks.en: Reports on the same question may emphasize different directions and knowledge chains even when their aggregate scores are similar. On this case, o3 Deep Research and GPT-5.6 Sol achieve breadth scores of 32.11 and 34.64, depth scores of 48.26 and 50.43, and overall coverage scores of 39.37 and 41.79, respectively. Despite these similar aggregate results, their branch-level coverage profiles differ substantially. Figure 9 summarizes both reports across the same ten research directions, making their differing emphases visible.
blocks.zh: 关于同一问题的报告可能强调不同的方向和知识链,即使其总分相似。 在本案中,o3"深度研究"和"GPT-5.6" Sol分别实现了32.11分和34.64分的宽分,48.26分和50.43分的深度分,以及39.37分和41.79分的总覆盖分. 尽管取得了这些类似的总体结果,但它们的分支一级覆盖情况差别很大。 图9总结了这两份报告在同一个十个研究方向上的情况,使其不同的重点可见一斑。

blocks.en: This case illustrates how reports on the same question can emphasize different parts of the underlying knowledge space. Branch-level analysis makes these differences visible by showing each report’s progression along knowledge chains within individual directions.
blocks.zh: 这一案例说明了关于同一问题的报告如何能强调基本知识空间的不同部分。 分支一级的分析通过显示每个报告在个别方向上的知识链上的进展,使这些差异明显可见。

blocks.en: E.3 More Research Activity Does Not Guarantee Higher Coverage
blocks.zh: E.3 更多的研究活动不能保证更高的覆盖率

blocks.en: I’d like a well-researched cultural history of Horn & Hardart, the automat chain, that goes beyond describing how the vending-style restaurants worked and instead examines why this company became such a durable fixture in American popular imagination. I’m especially curious about how the company built its public presence through sponsorship of broadcast entertainment in the early days of radio, including how those programs helped launch performers who later became famous, and how that kind of promotional and media involvement shaped its brand. Second, I’d like to understand why writers, songwriters, filmmakers, and stage productions kept referencing or recreating its dining rooms across decades and what the automat came to symbolize about class, city life, and nostalgia in songs, comedies, and films. Finally, please connect its rise and eventual decline to broader shifts in urban dining, entertainment, and changing tastes, so the report reads as an interpretive account of its lasting legacy rather than just a timeline of locations and menu items.
blocks.zh: 我更想了解Horn & Hardart的文化史, 即自发连锁店, 我特别好奇的是,公司是如何通过赞助广播娱乐来建立公众存在的, 包括这些节目如何帮助推出后来出名的表演者, 第二,我想了解为什么作家、作曲家、电影制片人和舞台制作人 几十年来一直引用或重新创建餐厅,以及自动制作在歌曲、喜剧和电影中象征阶级、城市生活和怀旧。 最后,请将它的兴起和最终的衰落与城市餐饮、娱乐和口味变化的更广阔的转变联系起来,因此,报告是对其长期遗产的解释性说明,而不仅仅是地点和菜单项目的时间表。

blocks.en: Table 24 summarizes the research activity, report length, and coverage scores of GLM 5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Flash on this case. Under the same frozen corpus, tool interface, workflow, and action budgets, GLM 5.2 makes more Search and Open calls, retrieves more pages, and uses more tokens, with part of its effort devoted to revisiting shared sources and expanding contextual discussion. Its report is also longer, yet DeepSeek V4 Flash achieves higher breadth, depth, and overall coverage. This case shows that greater research activity and longer reports do not necessarily imply higher knowledge coverage, highlighting the importance of effective planning and evidence selection.
blocks.zh: 表24汇总了研究活动、报告长度以及GLM 5.2和DeepSeek V4 Flash的涵盖范围。 在同一被冻结的宝库、工具界面、工作流程和行动预算之下,GLM 5.2提供了更多的搜索和开放电话,检索了更多的网页,并使用了更多的代号,部分工作致力于重新审视共享来源并扩展背景讨论。 它的报告也更长了,然而DeepSeek V4 Flash实现了更高的宽度,深度,以及总体覆盖. 这一案例表明,更多的研究活动和较长的报告并不一定意味着更多的知识覆盖面,突出了有效规划和证据选择的重要性。

blocks.en: Table 24 : Research activity and coverage on Horn & Hardart S03. Pages denotes unique Wikipedia pages returned during research.
blocks.zh: 表24: Horn & Hardart S03的研究活动和覆盖范围。 页面表示研究期间返回的独特维基百科页面.

blocks.en: E.4 Example Showcase
blocks.zh: E.4 示例显示

blocks.en: We present a report generated by o3 Deep Research for the query below, together with a representative subset of rubrics drawn from the corresponding local subgraph for analysis. We first show the query and the selected portion of the rubric tree (Figure 10 ), followed by the rubric texts and their satisfaction status (Table 25 ). We then present the full report with highlighted evidence and analyze its coverage of the selected rubrics.
blocks.zh: 我们提出由o3 Deep Research生成的报告,供下面的询问,以及从相应的本地子图中抽取的具有代表性的分集来分析. 我们首先显示查询内容和所选部分的路标树(图10),然后是路标文本及其满意程度(表25)。 然后,我们以突出的证据提交报告全文并分析其涵盖选定主题的情况。

blocks.en: I’m trying to understand the origins of the roguelike video game genre and would love a well-researched history that goes beyond just listing famous titles. I’m especially curious about how the genre actually came together in the late 1970s and early 1980s: what earlier interactive and exploration-style games inspired its first creators, how the hardware and display limitations of the era (things like the text-only machines and character-based screens that early developers had to work with) shaped its distinctive look and design conventions, and how tabletop role-playing traditions fed into its dungeon-crawling and narrative structure. I’d also like to understand who the key people were behind its formative early works and how the personal-computer platforms and distribution methods of that time affected which games reached players. Finally, please explain how these different technical constraints, cultural influences, and design choices interacted to define the genre’s core identity, and why certain defining features became so persistent even as computing itself changed dramatically afterward.
blocks.zh: 我试图了解无赖类电子游戏流派的起源, 我特别好奇这个流派是如何在20世纪70年代末和80年代初真正走到一起的:早期的交互式和探索风格的游戏如何启发了它的最初创造者,硬件和显示时代的局限性(像早期开发者必须与之合作的文本专用机器和字符屏幕)如何塑造其独特的外观和设计惯例,以及桌面角色扮演传统如何融入其地牢地窖和叙事结构. 以及当时的个人电脑平台和发行方法如何影响游戏的玩家。 最后,请解释这些不同的技术限制、文化影响和设计选择如何相互作用来界定流派的核心特征,为什么某些界定特征变得如此持久,即使计算本身在之后发生了巨大变化。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Representative rubric relations from the local subgraph with “Roguelike” as the root entity.
blocks.zh: 图10:以“Roguelike”为根实体的本地子图中的代表名称关系。

blocks.en: Depth and continuity along knowledge chains. This example illustrates depth through sustained coverage along related knowledge chains and continuity through coverage of their intermediate relations. Along R1 → \rightarrow R2 → \rightarrow R3 and R1 → \rightarrow R2 → \rightarrow R4, the report identifies Rogue as the genre’s forerunner and namesake (R1), explains its permanent-death mechanic (R2), and develops this account through practical enforcement and cultural connections. Specifically, R3 describes copying save files to circumvent permanent death and the authors’ use of save-file deletion to enforce it, while R4 connects permanent character death to tabletop role-playing traditions. All intermediate relations on these paths are covered, and R2–R4 have distinct supporting sentences within the same paragraph. The example thus makes both deeper coverage and continuity along the reference chains directly inspectable.
blocks.zh: 沿知识链的深度和连续性。 这一例子表明,通过持续覆盖相关知识链和通过覆盖其中间关系实现连续性,具有深度。 沿 R1 ~ 右手R2 ~ 右手R3 和 R1 ~ 右手R2 ~ 右手R4,报告确定了 Rogue作为流派的先行者和取名者(R1)解释了其永久死亡的机械师(R2),并通过实际的执行和文化联系来发展这一账户。 具体来说,R3描述了为规避永久死亡而复制保存文件以及作者使用保存文件删除来强制执行,而R4则将永久字符死亡与桌面角色扮演传统相连接. 这些路径上的所有中间关系都包括在内,R2-R4在同一段中有不同的辅助句子。 因此,这个例子使参照链的覆盖范围更深,连续性更能直接检查。

blocks.en: Logical coherence across sections. Consecutive parent–child rubrics in the reference tree can be satisfied by evidence from different report sections while still corresponding to logically connected knowledge. For R1 → \rightarrow R5, R1 is satisfied in the section that describes how Rogue was developed and widely distributed, explaining how it became the genre’s defining model. R5 is satisfied in the subsequent section that discusses early roguelike variants and their developers, describing how Hack’s creator attempted to recreate Rogue from memory. The discussion progresses from establishing Rogue’s foundational role to showing how its design influenced a specific successor, preserving the continuous reasoning across the section boundary and thus demonstrating meaningful depth. Similarly, R10 and R11 connect Beneath Apple Manor’s position before Rogue with its early use of procedural generation, bringing together complementary historical and technical information from separate sections.
blocks.zh: 各部门之间的逻辑一致性。 参考树中连续的父子分词可以通过不同报告章节的证据满足,同时仍然对应逻辑相通的知识. 对于R1 →\右旋R5,R1在描述Rogue如何被开发并被广泛传播的章节中感到满意,并解释了它是如何成为流派定义模型的. R5在接下来的章节中满足了讨论早期的roguelike变体及其开发者,描述了Hack的创作者如何试图从内存中再生Rogue. 讨论从确立Rogue的基础作用发展到显示其设计如何影响具体继承人,保留了跨分界线的持续推理,从而显示出有意义的深度。 同样地,R10和R11将Beneath Apple Manor在Rogue之前的位置与它早期使用程序生成连接起来,将不同章节的补充历史和技术信息汇集在一起.

blocks.en: Informative omissions in otherwise covered branches. R6 and R12 identify specific gaps despite coverage of their parent relations. R6 asks about Hack’s cross-platform ports and their use of graphical tiles, directly addressing the query’s interest in display constraints and platform changes. The report’s discussion of graphical tiles in Beneath Apple Manor does not satisfy this Hack-specific requirement. R12 asks about predefined seeds for generating large worlds; describing randomized dungeons alone does not explain this mechanism. R12 offers an optional technical extension to the discussion of memory-constrained design. Although unmet in this report, these rubrics remain valuable for the task, helping distinguish reports by the specificity and completeness of their knowledge coverage.
blocks.zh: 在其他涵盖的分支中不提供信息。 R6和R12找出了具体的差距,尽管其父母关系被涵盖。 R6询问了Hack的跨平台端口及其图形瓦片的使用,直接解决了查询对显示限制和平台变化的兴趣. 报告在Beneath Apple Manor对图形平面板的讨论并不能满足这个Hack特定的要求. R12询问产生大世界的预定义种子;单描述随机化地牢并不能解释这种机制. R12为讨论内存受限设计提供了可选的技术扩展. 虽然本报告没有提及,但这些主题对这项任务仍然很有价值,有助于根据它们的知识覆盖面的具体性和完整性区分报告。

blocks.en: Appendix F Local Research Framework
blocks.zh: 附录F 地方研究框架

blocks.en: The local research framework provides a common retrieval and orchestration setting for evaluating backbone LLMs. It standardizes the evidence corpus, tool interface, research stages, and interaction budget while leaving planning decisions, tool-use choices, and report generation to each backbone. Figure 11 summarizes the resulting workflow.
blocks.zh: 地方研究框架为评价主干法学硕士提供了共同的检索和整理设置。 它使证据库、工具界面、研究阶段和互动预算标准化,同时将规划决定、工具使用选择和报告生成工作留给每个骨干部门。 图11概述了由此产生的工作流程。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Local research framework workflow. The backbone LLM decomposes the research query into three Research Units, which execute concurrently against the shared frozen Wikipedia snapshot through Search and Open . Their evidence notes undergo one coverage-gap check; when a material gap is found, at most one Gap Unit collects supplemental evidence before the original query and all collected notes are synthesized into the final report.
blocks.zh: 图11:地方研究框架工作流程。 骨干LLM将研究查询分解为三个研究单位,通过Search and Open同时针对共享被冻结的维基百科快照执行. 他们的证据说明经过一次覆盖-差距检查;当发现重大差距时,大多数差距股在原始查询之前收集补充证据,所有收集的说明被综合入最后报告。

blocks.en: F.1 Retrieval Environment and Tool Interface
blocks.zh: F.1 检索环境和工具接口

blocks.en: All evaluations under the local research framework use the fixed English Wikipedia snapshot enwiki-20260701-v1 . The report generator receives the benchmark query. Provider-native web search is disabled, so every backbone searches the same time-invariant evidence space through the framework’s local tools.
blocks.zh: 当地研究框架下的所有评价都使用固定的英语维基百科快照 enwiki-20260701-v1. 报表生成器收到基准查询 。 提供商-本地网络搜索被禁用,因此每个骨干搜索都通过框架的本地工具进行相同的时间变化性证据空间.

blocks.en: The framework exposes two operations over this snapshot. Search and Open serve distinct roles: Search identifies potentially relevant Wikipedia pages, whereas Open reads their contents. Given a source identifier and a cursor position, Open returns a bounded text span. If additional text remains, it also returns a next_cursor that can be used to retrieve the subsequent span. All backbone LLMs use the same tool schemas, although they independently decide what to search for and which sources to read.
blocks.zh: 框架在这个快照上暴露出两个操作. 搜索和开放服务于不同的角色:搜索识别潜在的相关维基百科页面,而开放读取其内容. 如果有源标识符和光标位置, Open 返回一个有界限的文本跨度 。 如果额外文本还剩,它也会返回下一个可用来取回后续跨度的曲线。 所有主干 LLMs 都使用相同的工具策略,虽然它们独立地决定搜索什么以及阅读哪些源.

blocks.en: F.2 Research Workflow and Formal Configuration
blocks.zh: F.2 研究工作流程和正式配置

blocks.en: Table 26 : Key local research framework configuration. The same settings are used for all seven backbone LLMs evaluated under the framework.
blocks.zh: 表26:主要的地方研究框架配置. 在框架下评价的所有7个主干课程都采用了同样的设置。

blocks.en: Table 26 summarizes the configuration of our local research framework used for the seven backbone LLMs in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 表26总结了我们用于主要实验中七个主干有限责任公司的地方研究框架的配置。

blocks.en: Given a benchmark query, a planner first decomposes the task into exactly three non-overlapping Research Units, each defined by a short title and a bounded objective. The three initial Units execute concurrently. Within each Unit, the backbone uses Search and Open to investigate its assigned objective under fixed round and tool budgets, then returns concise evidence notes rather than a complete report. This decomposition preserves a common research structure while allowing each backbone to decide which queries to issue and which pages to read.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一个基准查询,计划员首先将任务分解为三个完全不相重叠的研究单位,每个单位由一个短标题和有限度的目标来定义. 最初的三个单位同时执行。 在每个股内,骨干使用Search and Open来调查固定回合和工具预算下为其设定的目标,然后返回简明的证据说明而不是完整的报告. 这种分解保留了共同的研究结构,同时允许每个骨干决定发布哪些查询和阅读哪些页面.

blocks.en: After the initial Units finish, the framework performs one coverage-gap check over the query and collected evidence notes. If the check identifies a material missing direction that can be investigated within the frozen Wikipedia snapshot, it creates one supplemental Gap Unit. The workflow therefore executes three Units by default and at most four Units in total, providing a bounded second stage of evidence collection without changing the protocol across backbone LLMs.
blocks.zh: 初始单元完成后,框架对查询进行一次覆盖差距检查并收集了证据说明。 如果检查能识别出一个在被冻结的维基百科快照中可以被调查的材料缺失方向,则会创建一个补充漏洞股. 因此,工作流程默认执行3个单位,总共最多执行4个单位,在不改变跨主干类有限责任公司协议的情况下,提供范围有限的第二阶段证据收集。

blocks.en: Finally, the synthesis stage receives the original query and the evidence notes produced by the Research Units and combines them into a coherent Markdown report. The resulting report is subsequently scored with the same rubric set and judge protocol used for all evaluated agents.
blocks.zh: 最后,合成阶段接收了研究单位制作的原始查询和证据说明,并把它们合并成一份连贯的Markdown报告. 由此产生的报告随后被同一套标语打入分数,判断所有被评价的代理人所用的协议。

blocks.zh: 附录一 人类注释议定书

blocks.en: I.1 Rubric-level annotation
blocks.zh: 一.1 Rubric级注释

blocks.en: The annotations support the rubric-level human–judge comparison in Section 4.5 . Ten PhD-level annotators participated in the human evaluation. The annotation sample comprised 3,695 report–rubric pairs from 12 reports, with each report representing a different benchmark domain. Under the annotation protocol, each pair receives two independent initial labels. Annotators do not have access to one another’s labels or the LLM judges’ verdicts. A third annotator adjudicates disagreements using the relevant report passages and the same annotation criteria, producing the final human reference.
blocks.zh: 说明支持第4.5节中人与法官的比较。 10名博士级注释员参加了人类评估。 注释样本包括来自12份报告的3,695份报告 -- -- rubritic pairs, 每份报告代表着不同的基准领域。 根据注解协议,每对得到两个独立的初始标签. 公证人无法查阅对方的标签或LLM法官的判决。 第三个注释员利用相关报告段落和同样的注释标准裁定分歧,得出最后的人文参考。

blocks.en: Each report–rubric pair received one of three labels: Satisfied , Partially Satisfied , or Not Satisfied . Satisfied indicates that the report explicitly states or clearly paraphrases the rubric’s required knowledge, including its essential relation and qualifications. Partially Satisfied indicates that the report covers a substantive part of the requirement but omits an essential detail or qualification. Not Satisfied indicates that the required knowledge is absent; merely mentioning a related entity or discussing the general topic does not constitute coverage. Judgments concern content present in the report, without filling gaps from external knowledge. Figure 12 illustrates the annotation interface during the report review process.
blocks.zh: 每个报告 - rubric 配对收到三个标签之一:满意、部分满意或不满意。 令人满意的是,报告明确指出或明确诠释了标题所要求的知识,包括其基本关系和资格。 部分满意表示,报告涵盖了要求的实质性部分,但略去了基本细节或限定。 不满意表明缺乏必要的知识;仅仅提及一个相关实体或讨论一般性专题并不构成涵盖范围。 判决涉及报告的内容,没有填补外部知识的空白。 图12说明了报告审查过程中的说明界面。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Human annotation interface. Annotators assign Satisfied , Partially Satisfied , or Not Satisfied to each report–rubric pair.
blocks.zh: 图12:人文注释界面. 注释者为每份报告指定满意、部分满意或不满意的对子。

blocks.en: Initial inter-annotator agreement was Cohen’s κ = 0.841 \kappa=0.841 , computed before adjudication over all 3,695 report–rubric pairs using the original three-category labels. The resulting human-reviewed labels serve as the reference for comparison with three LLM judges. We compare the judges’ original three-category verdicts with this reference. For the binary comparison, Satisfied is mapped to 1 (covered), while Partially Satisfied and Not Satisfied are mapped to 0 (uncovered), for both human and judge labels. Macro-F1 is computed separately for each report and then averaged equally across the 12 reports.
blocks.zh: 最初的注释者协议是Cohen = 0.841\kappa = 0.841, 对所有3,695份报告使用最初的三类标签进行裁决前计算。 由此产生的经人审查的标签是比较三名LLM法官的参考。 我们把法官最初的三类判决与这一参考进行比较。 对于二进制比较,满足被映射为1(被覆盖),而部分满足和不满足被映射为0(被覆盖),对于人和法官的标签都是. 宏语 F1为每份报告分别计算,然后在12份报告中平均平均计算。

blocks.en: I.2 Report-level expert assessment
blocks.zh: I.2 报告级专家评估

blocks.en: The report-level assessment in Section 4.5 comprises 72 reports from six deep research agents across 12 cases from distinct domains. Each case includes six reports answering the same research query. Ten PhD-level annotators participate in this assessment. For each case, the same three annotators from this pool independently rate all six reports on breadth, depth, and overall quality using a 1–10 integer scale, and their mean ratings serve as the human reference. Annotators assess reports without access to agent identities, automatically computed scores, or one another’s ratings. Differences among annotators are reflected in the mean rating.
blocks.zh: 第4.5节中的报告级评估包括来自不同领域12个案例的6名深入研究人员的72份报告。 每个案件包括六份报告,答复同样的研究询问。 10名博士级注释员参加了这一评估。 对于每个案例,来自这个集合的同一个三个注释员都用1–10整数尺度对六份报告的广度、深度和整体质量进行独立评分,他们的平均评分作为人类的参考。 说明员无法获取代理身份、自动计算得分或相互评分, 注释者之间的差别反映在平均评级中。

blocks.en: J.1 Benchmark Construction Prompts

blocks.en: J.1.1 Root Entity Neighbor Selection
blocks.zh: J.1.1 根实体邻居选择

blocks.en: This prompt selects the children of the root from candidate entities extracted across its complete Wikipedia page.
blocks.zh: 此提示从候选实体中选择根的子 。

blocks.en: ⬇ 1 You are selecting a set of directly related first - hop entities from the candidate links found in the full page of a core Wikipedia topic . These entities will become the main directions for later deep - research tasks , so you should balance direct relationship to the core topic , aspect coverage , and later composability . 2 3 Return ONLY JSON that follows the required schema . The JSON object MUST contain exactly two top - level keys : ‘ selected_candidate_ids ‘ and ‘ selected_neighbors ‘. 4 5 Rules : 6 1. Candidate scope and count : choose entities only from the provided ‘ candidate_neighbors ‘. The selection scope is the full - article candidate pool , including both lead - section and body - section candidates . If there are at least ‘ target_neighbor_count ‘ available unique candidates , return ‘ target_neighbor_count ‘ unique candidates . Return fewer only when the candidate list itself contains fewer available unique candidates than the target . 7 2. Selection objective : choose candidates that best support future root - centered deep - research tasks . Value here means research usefulness , aspect coverage , and composability for broad knowledge - coverage evaluation . 8 3. Coverage , combination , and duplicate filtering : prefer candidates that cover different research aspects of the root , and avoid concentrating on one narrow direction . Exclude highly similar titles , aliases , repeated directions , and obvious - common - knowledge or low - information candidates such as incidental mentions , dates , generic list pages , or weak parenthetical references . Form a differentiated branch set suitable for systematic DeepResearch . 9 4. Output structure : put the canonical selection in ‘ selected_candidate_ids ‘. blocks.en: ⬇ 1 You convert a set of hidden entity - relation clues into a research question that an outside user might ask . 2 3 Your task is to write ONE research - style query centered on the seed / root entity . This query will be given to a downstream DeepResearch model to generate a report , and coverage will be evaluated using rubrics corresponding to the hidden clues . ‘ subgraph_nodes ‘ is hidden construction context : use it only to understand the overall topical composition and depth profile . The final query must still present the root / seed entity as the explicit central topic . 4 5 Return ONLY JSON that follows the required schema . The JSON object MUST contain exactly one top - level key : ‘ query ‘. 6 7 Rules : 8 1. Central topic : the final ‘ query ‘ MUST clearly center on ‘ seed_entity ‘; the seed / root entity name may appear . The query should use the full hidden context to form a research task , rather than only asking about the root article itself . 9 2. Anti - leakage : the final ‘ query ‘ MUST NOT directly mention any entity name in ‘ forbidden_entity_names ‘, any exact title from ‘ depth_1_branch_inputs ‘, or any exact title from ‘ subgraph_nodes ‘ except the seed / root entity . Also avoid semantic leakage : do not rewrite hidden candidate entities , node titles , summaries , or relation explanations into downstream - facing concrete topics , mechanisms , institutions , places , events , works , methods , people , effects , or checklists . Deeper hidden entities may not all appear in the forbidden list , but the query should still not read like an entity checklist . 10 3. Writing style : imitate a thoughtful but non - expert user asking for research help . The query should be specific and purposeful , but should not make the user appear to know hidden entities , internal technical terms , hidden graph structure , or specific field methods . Use a natural - language paragraph . 11 4. Source of specificity : the query should usually be one coherent paragraph , around 100-200 words in English or a similar level of detail in the target language . It must not be too short or too generic , and it must not become specific by enumerating hidden candidate directions . Specificity should come from root - centered research framing , such as causal relationships , historical development , changes in evidence and interpretation , interactions among different forces , or how internal practices and external pressures shaped development .

blocks.en: ⬇ 1 You need to evaluate whether a report covers a set of predefined scoring points . 2 3 The input will include a user research question , several rubric objects , and the report to be evaluated . Each rubric object represents one specific knowledge point to check , and ‘ rubric_text ‘ is the only scoring criterion . Your task is to judge , item by item , whether the report satisfies the corresponding ‘ rubric_text ‘, and to provide a brief reason for each judgment . 4 5 Return only JSON that conforms to the required schema . 6 7 Rules : 8 1. Score each rubric object using only its ‘ rubric_text ‘ and a three - tier scoring scheme : ‘1‘ means satisfied , ‘0.5‘ means partially satisfied , and ‘0‘ means not satisfied . Base your judgment only on what is explicitly present in the report . Do not use external knowledge , common - sense completion , or subjective inference . 9 2. Assign ‘1‘ when the report explicitly states or clearly paraphrases the knowledge required by the rubric , covering the key facts , relationships , qualifiers , or numerical details required by the rubric . Reasonable paraphrases are acceptable , but the rubric must be substantively satisfied . 10 3. Assign ‘0.5‘ when the report mentions the core object , relationship , or fact required by the rubric and covers at least one substantive key element , but misses other key elements , qualifiers , dates , numerical values , causal links , or necessary context . General discussion of a related topic , mere mention of related terms , or content that does not cover any specific knowledge required by the rubric is not enough for ‘0.5‘. 11 4.
